tools.name: rtk
tools.notes: Token-optimized command proxy. Router rewrites grep/find/cat through rtk; rtk rewrite exit-code protocol (0/1/2/3) is version-coupled (unchanged through 0.50.0). Since 0.49.0: -l is GNU --files-with-matches under rtk grep (completing 0.47.0's -t/-m passthrough), rewrite handles safe pipes, peels process wrapper prefixes, and passes sudo commands through. Since 0.50.0: head/tail rewrites are faithful to the native commands (head window no longer reads past the lines requested, non-UTF-8 windows preserved), git/grep/dotnet/golangci arg parsing migrated onto a shared arg_tokenizer, and rtk gain reports weighted savings rates with signed saved-token sums (negative totals are possible; the metrics.ts negative-delta/clawback branch already handles them). The new rtk ast-grep output filter is search-shaped like rtk grep and stays pass-through — it is not in the blocked cat/read/smart code-reading family.

tools.name: jcodemunch
tools.notes: Indexed code search MCP server. Powers scout agent, router fallback, and Step 2.5 divert; wheel-URL uvx installs are supported transports.

tools.name: graphify
tools.notes: Knowledge graph builder. PyPI package name is graphifyy; repo moved to Graphify-Labs (safishamsi redirects); version-warns outside tested range. 0.9.53 writes no .rebuild.lock; its shrink guard keeps a partial build from overwriting graph.json, and since 0.9.53 (#3203) an unverified per-source shrink arms the guard and re-queues the source on the next run — a first run can legitimately return a smaller graph that a later run completes. Since 0.9.65 (#3697/#3695) the eviction pass re-checks the kept set, so a moved-file/symlink layout can no longer deadlock the shrink guard into refusing every update. Since 0.9.66 graph.json is deterministic across runs (PYTHONHASHSEED pinned via a one-time re-exec; the re-exec exit-code races that path introduced were fixed through 0.9.67/0.9.68), and 0.9.68 preserves cross-file imports/calls/uses edges into unchanged files on incremental updates (node/edge counts shift upward on multilingual repos — a /savings display change, not a parse change). 0.9.70 ships security fixes — GHSA-pcc4-rvhr-2pr8 (the Fortran cpp step no longer reads arbitrary host files via absolute/traversing #include during preprocessing; contents could previously be inlined into graph.json/GRAPH_REPORT.md and the LLM context), --watch snippet shell injection closed, Terraform secret redaction widened — plus five new language extractors in 0.9.66 (COBOL, VB.NET, R, Solidity, Erlang). Since 0.9.72: the update skill auto-refreshes stale installed skills without touching marker-bounded CLAUDE.md sections, and the GRAPH_REPORT.md community listing reuses the shared real-node filter so rationale/concept nodes no longer inflate counts (display only). 0.9.75-0.9.76 route graphify path and the MCP shortest_path tool through contains edges and resolve exact path::symbol endpoints before fuzzy matching, refusing ambiguous ones and failing closed on a file that defines no such symbol (#4004/#3935/#4264, behavior not protocol), and cross-repo resolver confidence snaps to the canonical INFERRED rubric (#4046, label-only — rig's EXTRACTED/INFERRED percentages can shift; the parse is unaffected). Since 0.9.78 node ids and manifest keys are portable (no checkout path or OS username leaks; a clone graphs identically), graph.json carries additive schema_version/graphify_version metadata (#4167, excluded from topology comparison since 0.9.79), and incremental update keeps placeholder nodes for never-scanned referenced files instead of dropping an unchanged referrer's cross-file edges (#4161). 0.9.80 caches the MCP traversal view per loaded graph (~1.6x query_graph, up to ~300x shortest_path) and raises the tree-sitter floor to >=0.25. 0.9.81 stops flagging plain AST declarations as knowledge gaps in GRAPH_REPORT.md and scales low-confidence AMBIGUOUS edges down before community detection (community counts shift; the real graph is untouched; GRAPHIFY_AMBIGUOUS_SCALE=1.0 restores). 0.9.82's one-time Cloud pointer prints only in an interactive terminal — piped/CI output (every rig exec) never sees it. Since 0.9.83 the AST cache is namespaced by grammar versions; 0.9.86 bumps the schema again (Rust grouped use, #4135) — each means a one-time re-extract on the first build after upgrading, landing on the next explicit graphify update, not at session start. 0.9.85 hardens the rebuild lock against a waiter-vs-release race (#4273); rig's mtime comparison (graph newer than a stale .rebuild.lock = ready) still keys on graph.json. Since 0.9.87: PHP Class::method() static calls resolve to the called method (self/static/parent routed, fail-closed; #3872/#3874), C# nested/generic partial types merge by full type path and var is typed from the return type (#4363/#4266, AST cache schema bump), Python @property reads link to the getter (#4337, AST cache schema bump), update refuses to drop a saved semantic node id when node totals grow (#4115, composing with the shrink-guard conservatism above), and the MCP query_graph per-term seed order no longer lets a weak early match lead an exact one (#4357). The GRAPH_REPORT.md summary/extraction layout that metrics.ts regex-matches is unchanged through 0.9.87, graph.json stays NetworkX node-link (0.9.86 additionally writes a committed copy as one compact line), and an existing project graph stays ready to rig — determineGraphState keys on graph.json, not the AST cache version.

tools.name: headroom
tools.notes: Context-compression proxy. Repo moved to headroomlabs-ai (chopratejas redirects); detected via headroom-init-claude hook marker or localhost ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL; /savings reads `headroom perf --format json`. Since 0.38.0: zip-bomb DoS bound and per-port proxy logs. 0.39.0 reworked the savings surface (new-input basis beside whole-wire, exact cache-read cost in rollups, lifetime output spend, negative savings reported instead of floored at zero) and added protect_messages plus TPM limiting; captureHeadroomStats gates on finite numbers, so signed tokens_saved passes and renders. 0.39.1 fixes 0.39.0's TPM limiter refusing large-context requests — pin 0.39.1, never 0.39.0.

tools.name: superpowers
tools.notes: Base skills framework (required). Detected via ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json; every chain skill wraps a superpowers:* skill. 6.3.0 SDD task-batching (#2078) is deliberately declined in sdd+ (per-task dispatch is load-bearing); the Spec: pointer (#2086) is emitted by plan+; brainstorming ceremony scaling (#2063) does not scale down the brain+ overlay. 6.4.1's TDD full-suite-during-the-loop rule (#2110) is deliberately declined for the tdd+/sdd+ loop — the full-suite green gate stays in verify+ where the zero-defect hook blocks (divergence documented in the tdd+ template); its plan handoff (#2258/#2318) is answered Subagent-driven in sdd+, with tdd+ as rig's native/inline peer; plan+ emits the Review Focus section (#2319) and spec-reviewer verifies its pinning tests. 6.4.2 reworks writing-plans as decisions-not-transcript (#2333: a test step names the test and its assertions, a code step the exact signature/file/spec values, a verification step the command and passing output) and adds a proportion self-review (a plan several times longer than its spec is a transcript); the plan+ overlay is already decision-level against "What a Step Contains" — no trim needed — but its mandatory sections (Constitutional Rules, Mock Policy, Spec: pointer, independence contract, Review Focus) can trip the proportion check on a small spec (model-driven; eval surface). 6.4.2 removed plan-document-reviewer-prompt.md (never referenced by rig) and swapped repo CLAUDE.md for AGENTS.md (detection reads installed_plugins.json, unaffected). All pinned 6.4.1 behaviors — #2110 full-suite rule, #2258/#2318 handoff, #2319 Review Focus — are still present in the 6.4.2 skill texts, so every documented divergence stands.
